entries.title: UFO 50

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route because it has the complete 50-game collection, including the collection's hidden unlockable content, in a native release with PC capture/settings flexibility. The Nintendo Switch version is a strong portable route, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over PC is documented.
primary.how_to_play: Buy UFO 50 on Steam for Windows PC and play the current native PC build.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or content-expanded edition exists; other platforms are TBA rather than released.
